name: Missing PO
definition: Invoice received without a valid purchase order reference
probable_root_cause: Non-PO spend, PO not created, wrong PO referenced
suggested_resolution: Obtain PO or process as non-PO per policy

name: Invalid PO
definition: Referenced PO does not exist or is not valid for this supplier/entity
probable_root_cause: Data entry error, wrong PO number, cancelled PO
suggested_resolution: Verify correct PO; request new PO if needed

name: PO Closed
definition: PO is closed but invoice references it
probable_root_cause: Late invoice, PO closed prematurely
required_data: PO status, invoice date, receipt history
suggested_resolution: Reopen PO or create new PO per policy

name: PO Exhausted
definition: Invoice amount exceeds remaining PO value
probable_root_cause: Scope change, partial invoicing, PO underfunded
suggested_resolution: Amend PO or split invoice

name: Price Mismatch
definition: Invoice price differs from PO price beyond tolerance
probable_root_cause: Price change, wrong PO line, currency issue
required_data: Invoice line, PO line, tolerance rules
suggested_resolution: Verify with supplier; amend PO or accept variance

name: Quantity Mismatch
definition: Invoiced quantity differs from PO/receipt quantity
probable_root_cause: Partial delivery, over-billing, unit mismatch
required_data: Invoice qty, PO qty, receipt qty
suggested_resolution: Verify delivery; adjust invoice or receipt

name: Missing Receipt
definition: Goods/services receipt not recorded for PO-based invoice
probable_root_cause: Receipt not entered, goods not received, service not confirmed
suggested_resolution: Confirm receipt; enter GR or escalate

name: Partial Receipt
definition: Receipt quantity less than invoiced quantity
probable_root_cause: Partial delivery, premature invoicing
suggested_resolution: Wait for balance or adjust invoice

name: Duplicate Invoice
definition: Exact duplicate of previously processed invoice
probable_root_cause: Supplier error, system resubmission
suggested_resolution: Reject duplicate; request credit if paid

name: Potential Duplicate
definition: Near-duplicate suggesting possible double billing
probable_root_cause: Similar invoice number, amount, date from same supplier
suggested_resolution: Investigate; confirm with supplier

name: Wrong Supplier
definition: Invoice from supplier not matching PO or master data
probable_root_cause: Supplier acquisition, wrong vendor selected, fraud
required_data: Supplier master, PO vendor, invoice header
suggested_resolution: Verify supplier identity; update master if legitimate

name: Incorrect Legal Entity
definition: Invoice addressed to wrong company entity
probable_root_cause: Multi-entity supplier confusion, wrong entity on PO
suggested_resolution: Reassign to correct entity or reject

name: Tax Issue
definition: Tax amount, rate, or registration inconsistent with rules
probable_root_cause: Wrong tax code, exempt supplier charged tax, cross-border issue
required_data: Tax tables, invoice tax lines, supplier tax status
suggested_resolution: Correct tax coding; request amended invoice if needed

name: Approval Missing
definition: Required approval not obtained per DOA
probable_root_cause: Approver unavailable, workflow gap, wrong routing
required_data: DOA matrix, approval history, invoice amount
suggested_resolution: Route to correct approver; obtain approval

name: DOA Issue
definition: Delegation of authority problem preventing approval
probable_root_cause: Absent approver, expired delegation, hierarchy gap
required_data: DOA matrix, delegation records, org chart
suggested_resolution: Activate delegation or escalate to backup approver

name: Coding Missing
definition: GL/cost centre/project coding not assigned
probable_root_cause: Non-PO invoice, unclear spend category
suggested_resolution: Assign coding per policy; confirm with requester

name: Invalid Cost Centre
definition: Assigned cost centre closed, invalid, or unauthorised
probable_root_cause: Org restructure, coding error, expired project
suggested_resolution: Reassign to valid cost centre

name: Invoice Quality
definition: Invoice document illegible, incomplete, or non-compliant
probable_root_cause: Poor supplier invoice format, damaged scan
suggested_resolution: Request corrected invoice from supplier

name: OCR/Extraction Issue
definition: Automated extraction failed or low confidence
probable_root_cause: Unusual format, poor scan quality, handwritten elements
suggested_resolution: Manual review and correction

name: Master Data Issue
definition: Supplier, item, or coding master data incorrect or stale
probable_root_cause: Incomplete onboarding, org changes, data migration
suggested_resolution: Correct master data; reprocess invoice

name: Banking Change Concern
definition: Supplier bank details changed recently
probable_root_cause: Legitimate change, potential fraud, acquisition
suggested_resolution: Verify change through established protocol

name: Credit Note Required
definition: Invoice should be credited rather than processed
probable_root_cause: Duplicate payment, overcharge, return
suggested_resolution: Request credit note; apply against open balance

name: Statement Discrepancy
definition: Supplier statement does not match AP records
probable_root_cause: Timing difference, missing invoice, payment in transit
suggested_resolution: Reconcile and resolve differences

name: Payment Hold
definition: Invoice or supplier on payment hold
probable_root_cause: Dispute, compliance, credit hold, audit
required_data: Hold reason, hold authority, invoice status
suggested_resolution: Resolve hold reason; obtain release authority

name: Disputed Invoice
definition: Invoice under active dispute with supplier
probable_root_cause: Quality issue, pricing disagreement, non-delivery
suggested_resolution: Resolve dispute; process or credit

name: Aged Unresolved Item
definition: Exception open beyond defined SLA
probable_root_cause: Any unresolved exception exceeding ageing threshold
suggested_resolution: Escalate; executive review if critical

name: System/Interface Error
definition: Technical failure in AP system or integration
probable_root_cause: ERP outage, interface timeout, data format error
suggested_resolution: IT resolution; manual processing if urgent
